import pytest

from src.lending.emi import emi


def test_zero_rate_splits_principal_evenly():
    # Arrange
    principal = 1200

    # Act
    result = emi(principal, 0, 12)

    # Assert
    assert result == pytest.approx(100)


def test_rejects_non_positive_months():
    # Arrange
    months = 0

    # Act / Assert
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        emi(1000, 0.01, months)
